C2.reason: principals is the membership table (unique org+user); there is no separate membership table. Note: principals.organisation_id is NOT NULL while the decision says nullable (orchestrator is asking Luca).

C3.reason: SSO (#355, qiick/laravel-oidc) is not merged yet, so Instituta has no user_identities table and no users.oidc_sub column.

C11.reason: Instituta follows the full-UUID decision (knowledge/decisions/2026-11-19-fleet-core-schema): api_keys uses its UUID primary key `id` as the public identifier, so a separate `uuid` column would duplicate it.

C21.reason: There is no Content-Language negotiation today; locale is stored per user and translated client-side.

C22.reason: API lists use next_cursor pagination, documented in OpenAPI, but responses use collection envelopes instead of the data/links/meta page envelope.

C24.reason: There is no X-Request-Id middleware today and request ids are not present in logs.

C25.reason: There is no Idempotency-Key replay today and no natural-key uniqueness for these creates, so a retried POST can duplicate.

C27.reason: Outbound webhooks are not part of the current product surface; Instituta does not emit Standard Webhooks envelopes yet.

C28.reason: Instituta's outbound HTTP calls still use Laravel Http/curl directly and do not yet route through the fleet SSRF pinning helper. Temporary security divergence; every call site is enumerated in https://github.com/qiick-io/instituta-core/issues/385.
